# telnyx_email_templates (Data Source)

Lists email templates, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_email_template`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_autoescape` (String) One of `false`, `true`.
- `filter_content_type` (String) One of `html_and_text`, `html_only`, `no_body`, `text_only`.
- `filter_query` (String)
- `filter_strict_variables` (String) One of `false`, `true`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `email_templates` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_templates))

<a id="nestedatt--email_templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_templates`

Read-Only:

- `autoescape` (Boolean) Whether HTML autoescaping is enabled for this template. When `true`, only rendered `html_body` expression output is HTML-escaped at the output boundary; `subject` and `text_body` are never autoescaped.
- `created_at` (String)
- `html_body` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `record_type` (String)
- `strict_variables` (Boolean) Whether strict variable validation is enabled for this template. When `true`, sends and renders that are missing a variable marked `required: true` in `variable_schema` fail with 422 naming the variable.
- `subject` (String)
- `text_body` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `variable_schema` (String) Structured variable requirements, or `null` when the template uses only the legacy `variables` array. A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `variables` (List of String) Persisted variable names. In `explicit` mode this array preserves the exact provided order, duplicates, and string contents; in `automatic` mode it is derived from the stored subject and bodies.
- `variables_mode` (String) `automatic` when variable names are derived from template content; `explicit` when `variables` is the exact manually managed array.
